title: STOKER’S WINTERGREEN TUB 12OZ FINE CUT
description:
STOKER’S WINTERGREEN TUB 12OZ FINE CUT

STOKERS WINTERGREEN TUB 12OZ FINE CUT is a snuff product based on fine cut tobacco. The fact that the tobacco is fine makes it moister and more flavorful. Stokers Wintergreen Tub 12oz is manufacture by National Tobacco Company and has a natural tobacco flavor with hints of wintergreen. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compare to similar snuff and dip products. Snuff and dip can also be experience in long and loose ground. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Skoal brand page. One tub equals 10 cans.
